platform_rules.rule: Private reply to a comment: only ONE message, within 7 days of the comment
platform_rules.implication_for_flow: The first DM must carry the hook + a button/question that makes the user reply; you cannot send a second automated message unless they respond. Process comments within 7 days (old reels go stale for automation).
platform_rules.excerpt: Only one message can be sent to the commenter ... within 7 days of the comment was made on the post or reel

platform_rules.rule: Follow-ups only after the user responds, and within 24h of that response
platform_rules.implication_for_flow: Ask questions as buttons/quick replies to keep the 24h window open; reminders/nudges must happen within 24h of the last user message; after that, move the lead to WhatsApp/email.
platform_rules.excerpt: Follow-up messages can only be sent if the recipient responds, and must be sent within 24 hours of the response

platform_rules.rule: 24-hour standard messaging window; Human Agent tag is Messenger-only (not IG Messaging API)
platform_rules.implication_for_flow: Founder must reply manually to DMs well inside 24h; no 7-day human-agent extension on Instagram (per policy page).
platform_rules.excerpt: Businesses have up to 24 hours to respond to a user. Messages sent within the 24-hour window may contain promotional content.

platform_rules.implication_for_flow: Open the DM with a light disclosure (e.g. 'quick auto-reply from FiguredOutAI, Tanishk will follow up personally').
platform_rules.excerpt: Automated chat experiences must disclose that a person is interacting with an automated service

platform_rules.rule: Rate limits: 750 private replies/hour per IG account for posts/reels; Send API 100 calls/s
platform_rules.implication_for_flow: Not a constraint at current volume; third-party claims of a 200 DMs/hour cap could not be confirmed in official docs (weak).
platform_rules.excerpt: 750 calls per hour per Instagram professional account for private replies to comments on Instagram posts and reels

platform_rules.implication_for_flow: Do NOT require a follow to get the audit link; ask softly at most. Follow-gating adds friction and policy risk for a B2B offer.
platform_rules.excerpt: Requiring users to engage (in the form of likes, shares, follows, or any other public-facing form of engagement) to gain access to specific, exclusive content

platform_rules.rule: Phone capture via quick reply only pre-fills from profile; hidden if profile has no phone; max 13 quick replies x 20 chars
platform_rules.implication_for_flow: Collect WhatsApp number via the booking form (Cal.com) or free-text, not relying on the IG phone quick reply. Keep button labels under 20 chars.
platform_rules.excerpt: If the user's profile does not have a phone number, Instagram does not show the quick reply.

platform_rules.rule: Messaging only after the user initiates; one customer per conversation
platform_rules.implication_for_flow: Comment or DM keyword is the required opt-in; no cold outbound automation.
platform_rules.excerpt: Only after an Instagram user has sent your app user a message can your app send a message to the Instagram user

benchmarks.metric: Show rate vs booking lead time
benchmarks.value: ~80.8% show for day-1 bookings, ~75% for first few days, ~60% by day 14 (6,414 meetings, Tito Bohrt via Chili Piper)
benchmarks.source_quality: medium (search snippet; not confirmed on fetched page)
benchmarks.excerpt: peaking at 80.79% for day 1 ... declines to around 60% by day 14
Same-day meetings ... roughly a 7% no-show rate ... 8+ days out: climbs past 23%

benchmarks.value: 66.7% of qualified submissions book vs ~30% industry average (~4M submissions)
benchmarks.excerpt: 66.7% of qualified form submissions book a meeting

benchmarks.value: Responding within 1 hour ~7x more likely to qualify lead (HBR 2011)
benchmarks.excerpt: nearly seven times more likely to qualify those leads

benchmarks.value: Meta-analysis pooled RR 1.11 (~11% higher attendance) for any reminder (healthcare)
benchmarks.excerpt: pooled risk ratio of 1.11 for attendance with any reminder versus usual care
Calendly's own sales users cut no-shows by around 28% with automated reminders

benchmarks.value: Opens 85-92%; DM link CTR 12-18%; one coach: 3,200 comments, 15% click, 22 calls booked (~0.7% of commenters)
benchmarks.excerpt: 3,200 comments with a 15% DM click rate and 22 discovery calls booked
25–40% of qualifying respondents booking a discovery call
an outbound no-show rate of less than 5%

patterns.pattern: Qualify by message (2-3 button questions), then send booking link; close on the call not in chat
patterns.excerpt: qualify, understand the problem, offer the next step, book the call

patterns.pattern: Keep qualifying questions minimal; ask service needed and company/role
patterns.excerpt: What service are you looking for? ... What's your company name and your role there?

patterns.pattern: Show the scheduler immediately after qualification; multi-form steps and slow calendars reduce bookings
patterns.excerpt: 66.7% of qualified form submissions book a meeting

patterns.pattern: Offer near-term slots (same/next day) and send day-before + day-of reminders
patterns.excerpt: There's data that shows a direct correlation between show rates going down and the meeting occurring further in the future.

patterns.pattern: Founder's assumption (PDF won't work after a product video): NO direct evidence found either way. Inferred: for a high-ticket custom service, a generic PDF adds a step; a small, specific asset (e.g. 'list of 5 automations for your business type' or a 60s WhatsApp demo) can serve as the value-first message while the CTA is the audit. Most coach funnels still lead with value then one qualifier then call offer (weak).
patterns.excerpt: value delivery (lead magnet, free resource) followed by one open-ended qualifier ... then transitions to a free strategy call offer

patterns.pattern: Do not follow-gate a B2B audit; policy lists follow-gating as spam
patterns.excerpt: Requiring users to engage (in the form of likes, shares, follows ...) to gain access to specific, exclusive content
